baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two coordinated clauses join رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ to أَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَاءً فُرَاتًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah composes a habitable order from contrasting material behaviors: elevated masses are made fixed, while potable water is actively conveyed to human recipients. The conjunction coordinates stability, height, supply, and drinkability without itself specifying a causal arrow from mountains to water.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or making into being frames the terrain arrangement as an effected order.
Settling firm and remaining fixed supplies the stationary pole of the mechanism.
Towering mountain-height gives the fixed masses vertical prominence.
Giving drink makes the water a delivered benefit rather than merely an environmental fact.
Ordinary water supplies the material conveyed to the addressed humans.
Fresh sweet water specifies usability and pleasantness, completing the provision mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists mountains and fresh water as two unrelated natural objects.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents a coordinated habitat: made fixity and height stand beside actively delivered, drinkable water.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative verb أَسْقَيْنَاكُم directly marks the plural audience as beneficiaries.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus shifts from the existence of water to a provider-recipient relation. Providing access, conveying water, and specifying its sweetness together portray sustained usability rather than a bare inventory of resources.

activation_trace.role: Providing a watering source contributes durable access and assigns the audience the role of beneficiary.
Supplying water by watering or pouring makes conveyance to recipients explicit within the model.
Fresh sweetness marks the supplied water as fit and welcome for drinking.

changed_reading.before: Fresh water happens to be present in the landscape.
changed_reading.after: The audience is deliberately given access to water whose potable quality is part of the gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence supplies a process vocabulary of dispatch, spreading, differentiation, and casting or delivery. Read back into the focus, the fixed heights can function as stable points within an ordered distribution field, while أَسْقَيْنَاكُم becomes the recipient-facing completion of movement rather than an isolated act.

activation_trace.role: Fixed settlement anchors the stationary element against the context's sequence of movement.
Providing a watering source anchors the proposed distribution process in the focus act.
Dispatch and setting forth initiate the context's ordered movement.
Opening, spreading, and branching extend dispatch into spatial distribution.
Differentiating between things gives the spread material ordered channels or destinations.
Casting something until it arrives supplies the terminal delivery image.

structural_cues: 77:1-5 forms an ordered participial chain of sending, spreading, separating, and casting before the focus later names water delivered to you.
Within 77:27, the stationary mountain phrase is immediately coordinated with a recipient-directed watering verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered movement lexemes and the focus's fixed-versus-delivered pairing; I supply the arrow that treats them as a reusable distribution grammar. A live alternative is that the opening agents concern revelation or judgment only and contribute no hydrological process to 77:27.

changed_reading.before: The watering is a self-contained benefaction beside static mountains.
changed_reading.after: The watering can be heard as the arrival stage of an ordered dispatch-and-distribution process, balanced by fixed high points.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first identifies elevated solid mountain masses and then removes them from place, scheduling the reversal within a day of separation. This converts رَوَاسِيَ from an emblem of absolute permanence into installed, presently effective stability whose term belongs to the same ordering power that made it.

activation_trace.role: Firm settlement states the focus condition that the context later reverses.
Towering height intensifies the apparent durability of what will be removed.
An elevated solid mass identifies the contextual object as the same mountain class described in the focus.
Uprooting and removal from place directly reverse settled fixity.
Assigning a time or limit places the reversal within a scheduled order.
Judgment that separates truth from falsehood makes the scheduled unmaking adjudicative rather than random.

structural_cues: 77:10 says the mountains are uprooted, whereas 77:27 calls the mountains fixed and towering.
77:11-13 places cosmic reversals within an appointed day of separation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies present fixity, future uprooting, timing, and separation; I infer that the focus praises contingent stability rather than intrinsic permanence. The alternative is to keep creation and final destruction as separate scenes without importing term-boundedness into the focus description.

changed_reading.before: The fixed mountains signify unqualified permanence.
changed_reading.after: Their fixity is a made and currently operative stability, impressive precisely though it can be ended at an appointed separation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated noun ماء carries the audience from weak, lowly origin-fluid to fresh water supplied for drinking. The focus's second-person object now completes a dependence arc: the humans addressed are water-derived in the preceding creation scene and remain water-dependent as recipients of sustenance.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink marks the created audience's continuing dependence on provision.
Water itself is the repeated material linking origin and sustenance.
Fresh sweetness supplies the positive quality at the sustaining end of the contrast.
Male fluid placed in the womb specifies the generative water at the origin end.
Lowliness and weakness contrast the origin-fluid's condition with the later water's freshness.

structural_cues: 77:20 and 77:27 repeat ماء with the contrasting modifiers مَهِين and فُرَات.
The humans created in 77:20 become the explicit plural beneficiaries in أَسْقَيْنَاكُم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated water, contrasting qualities, creation, and direct address; I supply the lifecycle arrow from origin to ongoing sustenance. A live alternative treats the two waters as independent examples with no intended dependency arc.

changed_reading.before: Fresh water is an external environmental amenity.
changed_reading.after: Fresh water continues the audience's water-dependence from its lowly generative origin into sustained life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent creation sequence builds nested containment: generative fluid is made to rest in a stable, secure place under measure; earth is then made a gathering vessel; within it, fixed elevations and potable water are installed. The pronoun فِيهَا lets the focus continue the earth-container, shifting scale from womb to inhabited world.

activation_trace.role: Making something enter a state anchors the focus as deliberate spatial arrangement.
Fixed settlement carries the preceding resting-place logic into the earth's interior.
A provided watering source turns containment into life-supporting access.
Fluid deposited in a womb supplies the first contained material.
Causing the fluid to occupy a condition repeats the focus's arranging verb.
Stability and settlement define the inner receptacle's holding function.
A place of being supplies the secure spatial enclosure.
Measured planning adds bounded duration and calibration to containment.
The lower realm opposed to sky identifies the larger container resumed by فِيهَا.
Gathering and holding in a vessel turns earth into the macro-scale receptacle.

structural_cues: 77:20-23 runs from fluid through making, secure settlement, and measured term.
77:25-27 runs from making earth a gatherer of living and dead to placing fixed heights and drinkable water within it.
The feminine singular pronoun in فِيهَا resumes the immediately named earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two making clauses, a secure resting place, measure, earth as gatherer, and the focus's within-it construction; I supply the scale analogy that treats womb and earth as nested life-holding systems. The live alternative is simple accumulation of adjacent creation signs without a microcosm-to-macrocosm correspondence.

changed_reading.before: The ayah begins a separate landscape example after the account of human formation.
changed_reading.after: The ayah enlarges the same calibrated holding architecture from generative enclosure to an inhabited earth containing anchors and potable supply.

context_deltas.mechanism: The universally addressed sweet-water gift is immediately followed by the refrain against deniers, then expanded into two opposed environments: a commanded movement toward shade that neither shelters nor blocks flame, and protected people amid real shades and springs who are told to drink pleasantly. Present provision therefore becomes both evidence and a material foretaste of later differentiated reception.

activation_trace.role: Giving the audience drink establishes the present provision later placed under moral contrast.
Fresh sweetness supplies the positive sensory quality echoed by pleasant later drinking.
Contradiction of truth turns the preceding provision into evidence capable of being denied.
The image of shade as covering begins a shelter claim that 77:31 immediately negates.
Actual covering shade supplies the positive environmental counterpart.
Putting oneself in protection identifies the recipients of the shelter-and-water environment.
A flowing water source carries the focus's potable provision into the positive outcome scene.
Taking in liquid makes the later benefit explicitly consumptive rather than merely scenic.
Enjoyment without harm or difficulty answers the focus water's fresh sweetness.

structural_cues: The denial refrain at 77:28 directly follows the focus provision.
77:30-31 offers a failed shade that cannot protect from flame, while 77:41-43 joins effective shade, springs, drinking, and pleasantness.
The two later environments convert shared present address into differentiated outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate denial, opposed shade scenes, springs, and pleasant drinking; I infer that current sweet water functions as evidence and anticipatory pattern. The alternative is that 77:27 concerns only worldly creation while the later springs are a wholly separate reward with no backward activation.

changed_reading.before: The sweet water is an unqualified present benefit shared by the plural audience.
changed_reading.after: The shared present drink also witnesses against denial and previews the later split between failed protection and genuinely sheltered, pleasant drinking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later command to enjoy briefly while being named offenders prevents the present water gift from functioning as proof of approval or permanence. The focus remains benefaction, but access can be a bounded allowance whose moral meaning depends on response rather than possession.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink supplies the present benefit whose duration and moral force are being qualified.
Fresh sweetness shows that a genuinely pleasant gift need not imply lasting approval.
Guilt and offense detach present consumption from moral endorsement.
A benefit enjoyed and used identifies worldly provision as real enjoyment.
Smallness and paucity impose the limiting horizon on that enjoyment.

structural_cues: 77:46 addresses a plural audience with consumption and enjoyment, as 77:27 addresses a plural audience with drink.
The qualifier قَلِيلًا and the predicate مُجْرِمُونَ jointly separate enjoyment from endorsement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later plural command to enjoy little and its offender predicate; I infer that this bounded enjoyment can qualify the focus's addressed provision. The alternative is that 77:46 describes respite generically and does not specifically reach back to the sweet water.

changed_reading.before: Receiving pleasant water implies an open-ended favorable standing.
changed_reading.after: Even genuine sweet-water provision can be temporary allowance, so possession does not by itself establish approval or permanence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant س ق ي to س و ق split and overlays driving on an ordinary watering form. It remains anchored to أَسْقَيْنَاكُم through that explicitly supplied mapped target and coheres with conveyed water; downstream prose should call it a transport resonance, not a replacement morphology or primary gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَسْقَيْنَاكُم can carry a packet-authorized secondary image of water being impelled toward recipients.

activation_trace.role: The split target contributes driving and impelling forward as an exploratory transport layer.
Supplying water by pouring gives the driven movement a concrete material and destination.
Fresh water keeps the exploratory motion attached to the literal object delivered.

changed_reading.before: We simply gave you fresh water to drink.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, We conducted or drove a supply of fresh water toward you for drinking.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a human pride branch of ش م خ inside a literal mountain adjective and opposes it to bodily bowing. It remains anchored at شَامِخَاتٍ and at the explicit lowering posture in 77:48; downstream prose should render a contrastive resonance between legitimate created elevation and refused humility, never call the mountains arrogant or erase their topographic height.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَامِخَاتٍ names literal elevation while its pride branch permits a posture contrast with refusal to bow.

activation_trace.role: Raising the nose in pride supplies an anthropomorphic posture latent beside literal mountain height.
Bending and lowering the head supplies the exact inverse posture that the addressed people refuse.

changed_reading.before: Towering is only a neutral measurement of mountain height.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, made mountain-height contrasts with humans who preserve a pride-like uprightness when called to lower themselves.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from literal hydrology to reception of discourse. It remains anchored through the water-root branch that explicitly includes sweetness or sheen in speech, the focus's act of giving drink, and the final حديث and heart-settling belief; downstream prose should present an analogy of reception, not identify the water with revelation or turn فُرَاتًا into a lexical description of speech.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَاءً فُرَاتًا provides a literal act of making recipients take in something fresh and beneficial.

activation_trace.role: Giving drink supplies the receptive relation used by the cross-domain analogy.
Water-like freshness extending to sweetness of speech authorizes the material-to-discursive bridge.
Fresh sweetness keeps the proposed discourse reception modeled on a beneficial literal drink.
Renewed speech or report supplies the discourse presented for reception at the surah's close.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the inward reception analogized to taking in drink.

changed_reading.before: The focus offers only a material sign, while the final discourse question is unrelated.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, being given fresh water models the offered reception of discourse that should settle inwardly but may still be refused.

strongest_changes: The mountains' fixity became contingent and term-bounded when 77:10-13 supplied their scheduled uprooting and separation.
The sequence from origin-fluid to secure receptacle to earth-as-container changed 77:27 into the macro-scale continuation of calibrated life support.
The denial refrain and opposed later environments changed present sweet water into both evidence and a foretaste of differentiated shelter and drinking.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package made the focus oscillate between present construction and future reversal, and between universally addressed provision and morally differentiated reception. Its split root mapping also preserved a form-distant but mechanistically useful image of water being driven toward recipients.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus juxtaposes mountains and water but does not syntactically state that the mountains cause, store, or channel the water.
The opening dispatch-and-distribution sequence may concern agents of revelation or judgment without activating a hydrological process.
The link between worldly sweet water and later springs is rhetorical and structural, not an asserted identity.
The posture, driven-water, and speech-as-drink readings depend on branch-distant or cross-domain resonance and should remain exploratory.
